Small fixes for Minecraft 1.21.6 to 26.3 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

Pick the file that matches your game, same as 0.7.0. If automatic updates are on, SkyLyrics fetches it for you.

### New

- **Slide apart (World layout).** If two floating words still end up on top of each other, the newer one glides out of the way to the nearest clear spot. On by default; switch it off under **Look → Position**.
- **Library search feels alive.** While it looks for songs you see a small moving equaliser instead of "Nothing found", and "Nothing found" only shows once the search has really come back empty. Before you type, your recent searches are there to tap again.
- **Locked playlists play.** Playlists made by someone else, which Spotify won't let apps look inside, now play from the top when you click them instead of only showing a message.

- **A short welcome tour** the first time you start the game with the mod: pick a look, choose where the lyrics go, try the demo song and see the keys. It shows once; existing installs skip it.

### Fixed

- **World words follow you mid-line.** If you turn away while a line is being sung, the rest of it carries on where you're looking instead of behind you. Standing still, the words keep writing along the same line, so they still don't pile on top of each other.
- **Open Music tab** in the song library now scrolls straight down to the Spotify card, so you land where you sign in. Before, it could drop you back at the top of the Music tab, which looked like nothing happened.
- **World words no longer sink into the ground or walls.** Every corner of a word is checked, not just its middle; a word that would be half buried moves closer or floats up out of it.
- **World words no longer pile up on each other.** When a new word has to land on an older one, the older one fades out first, so you never read two words through each other.
- **Buttons work in big mod packs.** Some packs (seen with Immersed With Shaders on Windows) swallowed mouse clicks, so you could hover the settings and library but not press anything. The screens now notice a click that never arrived and handle it themselves.
- **World words show with shader packs.** Some packs (seen with AstraLex) drew the floating words as black boxes. With shaders on, the words now use Minecraft's own letters, which every pack draws right.
